meaning_scope: Static policy main body: introduction and articles1–10 read; navigation and linked documents not expanded. No dynamic validation/actual submission/server recipient check.

personal_information.definition: Article1 lists name, company name, address, phone/FAX/email and other identifying descriptions.

purposes.finding: General policy lists contract/billing, answering enquiries including identification, service/news/campaign/other-service emails, necessary maintenance/important contact and incidental purposes.

form_specific_notice.finding: Saved IR form separately says submitted personal information is used only to respond to the enquiry. Preserve that narrower form notice alongside general policy; do not infer priority, change the prior text or expand actual consent.

recipient_and_third_parties.third_party_provision: Article5 says no provision without prior consent except specified/statutory exceptions, including life/body/property, public health/children and public-authority cooperation conditions.
recipient_and_third_parties.not_third_party_cases: Necessary delegation, business succession, and specified joint use with prior notice/readily accessible disclosures are described separately.
recipient_and_third_parties.named_processors_or_actual_joint_recipie: Not identified in the reviewed policy text; no actual routing/processing disclosure inferred.

retained_data_and_rights.finding: Article6 disclosure on personal request has stated non-disclosure exceptions and a 1000-yen fee; this is personal-data access, not a charge for an IR answer. Article7 allows correction/addition/deletion requests for erroneous data under company procedure. Article8 addresses improper/beyond-purpose use, necessary investigation, conditional suspension/erasure and alternatives where specified.
retained_data_and_rights.retention_term: No concrete retention/deletion schedule established in reviewed policy.

policy_contact.meaning: Policy enquiries only; not certified as an IR reply destination or new permitted outreach channel.

change_clause.finding: Article9 permits changes as stated and generally makes revised policy effective on website posting. No dated version/earlier availability or future persistence is certified.

IR_reply_use_conditions.finding: No explicit IR-answer republication/secondary-use clause found in this reviewed static policy scope. Privacy handling consent concerns submitted personal data; it does not establish permission to republish, reuse or classify a future individual reply as public. Missing clauses are not permission.
IR_reply_use_conditions.other_possible_individual_reply_conditio: Unobserved future reply wording/publication evidence must be checked separately.

prior_contact_conditions_retained: Earlier form required fields/individual company-name instruction/phone-or-letter possibility remain as previously observed; privacy acquisition does not confirm response guarantee, actual delivery, effective validation, quiet period or acceptance qualification anew.
